description: Loopback dial scope for every target except iOS (GDK-1581). Tauri v2 resolves capability files identically for dev and build (tauri-utils acl/build.rs parse_capabilities globs the directory for both), so there is no dev-only capability — `platforms` is the only lever that keeps these entries out of the App Store binary while non-iOS development builds keep them. Nothing on iOS needs them: dev rides window.fetch through the vite scheme proxy (lib/api.ts pickFetch never loads plugin-http when IS_DEV), and a packaged phone has no peer on its own 127.0.0.1 — the historical justification was 'dev and USB', and no USB feature exists. src/lib/dial-scope.test.ts unions this file with default.json and pins that union to the TS predicate entry for entry.
